notes: Very close call between two strong, genuinely two-style pages. B has the more distinctive and more unified identity (Swiss poster + blueprint instrument chrome carried through every section) and the sharper rationale, but it ships visible rendering nicks (clipped chart label, struck-through radar labels) and a real accessibility gap (unlabeled content SVGs, no focus styles, no main landmark). A is more conventional visually yet executes its frame-and-instrument concept defect-free with clearly better semantics and accessibility; on the weighted rubric (usability 15 + technical 15) A edges ahead, 4.23 vs 4.15.
